_howTo: Each project is one wide card. Easiest: use the admin page (the small dot at the bottom of the site) and open the Projects tab. Fields: name, department, status (optional), description, images (a photo carousel; each can have a caption), team (the project's leaders: name, role, year, photo, linkedin; "lead": true puts someone first), facts (short highlight lines; [text](https://link) makes a link) and url (optional Learn More button).

projects.name: FIRESAT
projects.description: FIRESAT (Fire Intervention and Rescue Expedition Satellite) is a student-led aerospace research initiative developing a high-altitude weather balloon demonstrator as an initial step toward a future 2U CubeSat mission in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). The project aims to test and validate the performance of a Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 (CM5) running the Sundance AI model for thermal-based wildfire detection under stratospheric conditions. This early-stage testing will help evaluate the system’s ability to operate under mission-relevant environmental conditions and inform its potential future integration into a CubeSat.
facts: 4 sub-teams: Mechanical, Electrical, Systems and Software
